seo.title: TarjimVideo — Video subtitle translation
seo.description: Translate the speech of any video into subtitles in Arabic and other languages. Works from the browser or the Telegram bot.

translate.title: Translate a video's speech into subtitles
translate.intro: Upload a file or paste a link. You get a subtitle file (.srt / .vtt) in the language you choose, or the video with the subtitles burned in.
translate.link_hint: A public video link (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and many more) or a direct link to a video or audio file. YouTube links are not supported: upload the file instead.

telegram.title: Use it from Telegram
telegram.intro: The same translation service, without leaving your chat app.

steps.title: Open the bot and press Start
steps.body: It explains what it can do, in English or Arabic depending on your Telegram language.

steps.title: Send a video file or a link
steps.body: Files sent in the chat can be up to 20 MB (a Telegram limit); use this website for larger videos. Public video links work too (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and more), except YouTube.

steps.title: Choose what you want back
steps.body: A subtitle file (.srt), or the video with the subtitles burned into the picture. Use /lang to change the target language.

steps.title: Wait for the result
steps.body: The bot shows live progress and sends the files into the chat when they are ready.
